six_design_requirements.requirement: Train/VAL/test read only zE at the original q-centered crop scalar; if retaining9x9 map it is fixed element[4,4] in every phase. No GT r/unc sampled map, no source mosaic, no best tile, no uncertainty-mean source classifier.
six_design_requirements.reason: Eliminates the stated source-region/mosaic vs original-query-centre operator mismatch. It does not establish transfer or native part semantics.

six_design_requirements.requirement: New separate2D aux cue_refID, sealed before-only r+uncertainty and target association, original renderer/native predicted slot only provenance. Multiple candidates require U unless crop-only evidence distinguishes the intended cue; do not choose nearest foreground or bbox corner.
six_design_requirements.reason: A scalar with no target/cue-identity input cannot resolve mutually inconsistent cue labels for identical crops.

six_design_requirements.requirement: The observed cue must be a localized junction/edge endpoint/foot-or-opening boundary whose structural role and target ownership can be stated. Texture/wood pixels, darkness, holes and crop-background alone never assign D/E/S.
six_design_requirements.reason: Preserves the original corner/part visibility goal rather than pixel membership.

six_design_requirements.requirement: Full opaque foreign cover of the sealed cue; no q/r/L motion. Add same-donor sham-paste with cue untouched and an unmodified before, with seeds/coverage parameters fixed before outputs. Recompute after RGB features from actual after RGB if features later used.
six_design_requirements.reason: Tests cue loss rather than pasted-object presence, seam detector, stale P3 or merely whole-crop material loss.

six_design_requirements.requirement: Retain160original slots and typed38inputU. Training-known eligibility and its rejected counts are separate from all-slot end-to-end coverage. Weight each unique physical cue/capture/view total1, not each overlapping native slot or after draw.
six_design_requirements.reason: Avoids apparent data growth from repeated cues, family leakage or U-as-negative.

six_design_requirements.requirement: Seal labels/recipes/splits/metrics before any new forward; one candidate and source-heldout selection only. Current223 remains excluded from all choices/fit and is not read here.
six_design_requirements.reason: An auxiliary pass is not fullgoal completion; later current comparison only after explicit sourcefreeze/admission.

input_and_scale_contract.original_source: Exactly original20 prediction rows, selected firstargmax and q0..7; no alternative target or recentered q. Future expanded corpus must run the same GT-free initializer before annotation.
input_and_scale_contract.q_L: Keep the exact existing q8 and metadata-derived L; no GT radius, box enlargement, r centering,128/256 grid or source-only rescaling.
input_and_scale_contract.RGB: Same canonical RGB96+valid96 geometry already audited. q is RGB96 coordinate47.5; a 9x9 evidence map centre[4,4] is a learned crop output, not a native pixel GT.
input_and_scale_contract.input_tensors_candidate: Local RGB/valid, optionally original frozen localP3 under a separate prospective model protocol; no GT r, uncertainty, sourceid, crop label, mask, pose/depth, nativeID or targetcue text in learned forward.
input_and_scale_contract.reference_GT_only: r/uncertainty/targetassociation establish label eligibility and diagnostics only, never choose an input crop or scoring location.
input_and_scale_contract.reference_coverage: Use unchanged halfopen original crop [qx-L/2,qx+L/2)×[qy-L/2,qy+L/2), require whole uncertainty FULL for known label. PARTIAL and MISS remain named U reasons. FULL does not guarantee visual observability.
input_and_scale_contract.primary_random_q_jitter: None: this candidate explicitly learns the frozen initializer q/L distribution. A separate later jitter experiment must version inputs/semantics, not silently expand L.

controlled_generation_candidate.precondition: Reference and uncertainty sealed from unmodified before RGB without alpha/model/SAM selection. All selected source before rows retained, failures retained as U.
controlled_generation_candidate.geometry: Deterministic SHA(id,cue_refID,draw,partition) RNG after split. Opaque alpha=1 covers whole fixed cue uncertainty and named part-line support with a fixed margin chosen before output; no alpha threshold search. Do not move r or q after composition.
controlled_generation_candidate.donors: Public RGB-only foreign object patches from the same TRAIN/VAL partition, never same target/capture donor; donor provenance/licence bound. TRAIN and VAL donor capture families disjoint. A foreign opaque pasted object may not be called real natural occlusion.
minimum_controls_per_before: one cue-cover opaque after Caux if coverage certified
one sham after using same donor/rendering pipeline outside cue; Daux only if original cue demonstrably preserved
optional multiple draws count as augmentation not independent new cues
controlled_generation_candidate.randomization: Freeze translation/scale/angle/opacity interpolation and seeds before rendering. Same compositing/resampling path across cover and sham, no class-specific seam/border/text marker. Include both small and larger cover away from cue at predeclared probabilities; no score-directed hard-case generation.
controlled_generation_candidate.competing_cue_rule: Covering r while another indistinguishable q-compatible cue remains visible does not certify generic cue absence: mark after U or use a separately labelled multiple-cue problem. Do not force C.

split_and_weights.fixed20: TRAIN subset2/3/5:12frames, VAL subset1/4:8frames; preserve old groupHOLD and all unavailable. No new independent-site claim.
split_and_weights.group: All original/cover/sham variants, same physical cue repeated across slots, and near-temporal/capture-family duplicates remain in one partition. All source-only label proposals/family uncertainty must be explicit.
split_and_weights.per_group_weight: Total weight1 per unique source physicalcue/view across duplicate slots/draws; before/cover/sham components separately reported, balanced class sampling never counted as real class prevalence.
split_and_weights.U: Loss0; retain in overall rows, inputhold/associationhold/MISS denominators. No source-class ID in model inputs.
split_and_weights.selection: One source-only model candidate, same qcentre operator for all partitions; fixed source-heldout known-class macroBCE with no threshold search, preserve all checkpoints and choose earliest strict minimum under a root-frozen schedule.

minimum_data_and_stops_candidate.not_statistical_guarantee: The following are proposed engineering preconditions, not a power calculation, confidence bound, or permission to claim independent captures. Root must accept/freeze before new annotations/composition.

Controlled paste may be easier than natural cardboard/overlap

cons: Free-text confidence is not calibrated occlusion probability; absence of visible cue is not a natural E witness
Fullcontext/multimodal prompt is a new input operator and must be versioned; cannot compare as same crop-only scalar

Additional compute/licence/runtime constraints and no verified performance on these public slots
fair_candidate_contract: One checkpoint/version, fixed prompt/outputschema and decoding, all20+160q retained
Only originalq/selectedbox and public RGB in prompt; no r/GT masks/source labels/currentexamples
Return targetassociation/cueevidence/U and cite visible evidence; refuse D/E/S gold where correspondence missing
Use independent source reference review for scoring; VLM output must not become both training label and validation truth
No prompt/model hopping after source failure, no best-of answer selection
VLM_comparison.first_action: A bounded semantic feasibility audit may be distinct useful work, but it is not a justified substitute for missing same-reference truth or evidence of solved native visibility.
